channel.title: RDD Software blog
channel.description: Practical advice on building websites, online shops and apps: prices, choosing the right solution and preparing a brief. By RDD Software from Rijeka.

item.title: Domain and hosting: how to choose them and why they must be in your name
item.description: The domain is the address, hosting is where the site lives. How to choose both, what to watch for at renewal and why both must be in your name, not the agency's.

item.title: Website maintenance: what it covers and when it pays off
item.description: Updates, backups, small changes and support: what website maintenance really covers, when it pays off and when you can do without it.

item.title: How much does a website cost in 2026?
item.description: What drives the price of a website or online shop, which costs come after launch and what to look for when you compare offers.

item.title: Website, online shop or web app: what do you actually need?
item.description: The differences between the three most common solutions, explained with real projects and questions that help you decide.

item.title: How to prepare a software project brief and get an accurate quote
item.description: A checklist of what to know before you send an enquiry, with a template you can copy and the most common mistakes.
